indexPath.description: Storage path for vector index (relative to project root or absolute)

respectGitignore.description: Whether to skip files and directories matched in project .gitignore

supportedExtensions.description: List of file extensions to include in indexing (e.g. [".ts", ".tsx", ".py", ".md"])

customExcludes.description: Additional glob patterns to exclude from indexing

maxFileSizeKb.description: Maximum file size in KB to index

embeddingModel.description: Hugging Face model ID for embeddings

queryMultiplier.description: Candidate multiplier for LanceDB search oversampling
